q: In Joel, what kind of insects ate up the land?
quote: What the devouring locust has left, the swarming locust has eaten

q: In Joel, God promises to pour out His Spirit on whom?
quote: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people.

q: In Joel, who will be saved?
a: Everyone who calls on the LORD
quote: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved

q: In Joel, what should you rend instead of your garments?
quote: So rend your hearts and not your garments

q: In Joel, how is God described when calling people to return?
quote: For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

q: In Joel, what does God promise to repay?
quote: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts

q: In Joel, when the Spirit is poured out, what will young men see?
quote: your young men will see visions.

q: Who was the prophet Joel's father?
why: The word of the LORD came to Joel.
quote: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel

q: In Joel, where will there be deliverance?
why: Among the remnant called by the LORD.
quote: for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance
